hook: Why Mouth Breathers Are Always Tired

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Right now, <#0.2#> is your mouth slightly open?
voices.caption: Right now, is your mouth slightly open?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Breathing through your mouth <#0.2#> takes more from you than you think.
voices.caption: Breathing through your mouth takes more from you than you think.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Your sinuses make nitric oxide, a molecule that helps widen blood vessels. <#0.2#> Breathe through your mouth, and you skip it.
voices.caption: Your sinuses make nitric oxide, a molecule that helps widen blood vessels. Breathe through your mouth, and you skip it.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: At night, your mouth dries out, <#0.2#> snoring gets more likely, <#0.2#> and deep sleep gets harder.
voices.caption: At night, your mouth dries out, snoring gets more likely, and deep sleep gets harder.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Today, close your mouth and breathe only through your nose. <#0.3#> Your body will notice first.
voices.caption: Today, close your mouth and breathe only through your nose. Your body will notice first.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: If your nose is often blocked or you snore heavily, <#0.2#> please see a doctor.
voices.caption: If your nose is often blocked or you snore heavily, please see a doctor.
